_comment: Research worksheet. The agent fills this from live search, then `research.mjs score` ranks it. Costs are entered by hand from real AliExpress listings — there is no connector. Momentum is a 0-100 judgement backed by the cited sources; leave it null rather than guessing.

candidates.name: Scalp Relief Brush
candidates.tagline: Five minutes that undo a whole day of tension.
candidates.demoIn3s: Hand draws the brush across a scalp; hair lifts and separates behind it.
candidates.problem: Your head feels tight before the day is even over.

candidates.name: Rotating Spice Carousel
candidates.demoIn3s: Cluttered cabinet, then one spin and every label faces forward.
candidates.problem: You buy the same spice twice because you cannot see what you own.

candidates.name: LED Therapy Mask
candidates.demoIn3s: Room goes dark, mask lights up.
candidates.problem: Clinic sessions cost more than the device.
candidates._note: Rejected on margin and price band — high ticket, needs a warmed audience and compliance review on any skin claim.

candidates.name: Magnetic Cable Tidy
candidates.demoIn3s: Tangle of cables snaps into a row.
candidates.problem: Cables slide off the desk every time you unplug one.
candidates._note: Below the impulse band and momentum floor — good demo, thin economics.

candidates.name: Posture Band
candidates._note: Vetoed — nothing to show in three seconds, unsourced, and wellness claims invite regulatory risk.
